problems: Program was 1 resident/year (6-yr then 7-yr) until the 2020 expansion to 2/yr; 2014 had 2 (Kim, Wainwright). The 2024 entry class appears on no page (either never listed, or none matched). Four AYs reconstructed (2012-13, 2016-17, 2018-19, 2024-25): the pages were stale or unarchived in those years. Ronecker graduated 2018 after 6 years (entry 2012). Phase 1 Common Crawl: 66 crawls 2012-2019 nymc.edu + 2024-2025 WMC/wmchealth; still-failed pairs are for dead paths in covered years (CC-MAIN-2014-52 depthome, 2015-22 /neurosurg/, 2017-51 depthome, 2018-09 /neurosurg/, 2019-13 /neurosurg/, 2024-38 wmchealth, 2025-43 neurosurgery2) and were not retried in phase 2 because the target paths did not exist or were frozen in those windows. Phase 2: live wmchealth.org is Cloudflare-blocked to curl (no bypass attempted); used Wayback 2026-09-24 capture instead. NPPES taxonomy/city searches cap at 1200 rows per query and some pages errored (15 of ~40 query pages), so the Valhalla enumeration list is not exhaustive.
